gramercyNote: Gramercy Park is one census tract with 135 sidewalk segments, so its figures may not be comparable with other neighborhoods.

chart3Footnotes.text: Blended asking rent: total annual asking rent divided by total square feet quoted (ground floor plus lower and other levels). Asking rents were quoted by landlords' listing agents in November 2026.

NNN (triple net): the tenant pays property taxes, insurance and common-area maintenance in addition to the rent shown, so this figure is not directly comparable with the other asking rents. Quoted on all floors (7,500 SF).
Based on a single asking-rent quote. It is not an average.

Figures reflect available spaces, mostly on side streets and secondary frontage, not prime corridor frontage. They run below the prime-corridor averages reported in brokerage research and are not directly comparable.
TriBeCa asking rent combines all TriBeCa listings and is shown in both TriBeCa rows.
